market_news.paragraph: Global equities were mixed in the latest completed round of trading, with 11 of the 24 benchmarks tracked on this page closing higher. In the United States, the S&P 500 rose 0.47 per cent to 7,711.76, the Dow Jones rose 0.18 per cent to 53,560, the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.04 per cent to 26,402 and the Russell 2000 fell 1.12 per cent to 2,972.37. In Europe, the FTSE 100 fell 0.49 per cent to 10,824, the DAX rose 1.08 per cent to 26,570 and the CAC 40 fell 0.72 per cent to 8,401.18. Across Asia, the Nikkei 225 rose 0.22 per cent to 66,406, the Hang Seng fell 0.27 per cent to 25,585, the KOSPI fell 0.28 per cent to 6,788.88, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.01 per cent to 3,952.18, the BSE Sensex fell 0.27 per cent to 77,265 and the Straits Times fell 0.38 per cent to 5,699.93. Elsewhere, the Ibovespa rose 0.62 per cent to 175,665. Locally, the S&P/ASX 200 fell 0.39 per cent to 9,092.30 and the All Ordinaries fell 0.48 per cent to 9,294.30. In digital assets, bitcoin changed hands at $78,320, up 0.11 per cent over the past 24 hours. In currencies, the US dollar bought 1.3899 Australian dollars, down 0.06 per cent against the prior business day's fix. Index levels, exchange rates and commodity prices on this page are captured live at build time from the sources linked in each section; no forward-looking view is offered here.
